author: UncondemnedSinner
body:
I summoned my first Bezerk with Monster Remains..... and boy did he "Remain".   I managed to get a Level 150 Bezerk Ronin....... and I was level 110.   He stayed at my home for nearly 3 weeks while I kept chipping away at him.

All the monsters that I used to daily fight before going to work started hiding behind him and pretty soon I couldn't fight anyone because they all stood their ground behind the big tough guy.    This was before monsters started moving around as much as they do now.
